summary.en: The count sorted into the answer: the ledger card pushes in to the full page, the heap splits into piles with a share and chips; then one pile splits again into what needs a judgement and the rest.
summary.zh: 把计数分成答案：账本卡片推成整页，一堆分成几堆，标出比例和例子；再把其中一堆拆成需要判断的和其余的。

fits: The answer of an explainer told as shares of the same items.
notFor: More than two groups at the first split; exact percentages that must be read to the decimal.

intent.en: Let the viewer feel the proportion first, then read the figure, then see the part that still needs a person.
intent.zh: 先让观众感到比例，再读到数字，再看到其中仍需要人的那一部分。

content.en: Two groups (count, colour, share ≤ 6 chars, count line ≤ 14 / 7, up to three example chips ≤ 12 / 4); the second may split in two with a label (≤ 14 / 6).
content.zh: 两组（数量、颜色、比例 ≤ 6 字符、数量说明 ≤ 14 / 7、至多 3 个例子 ≤ 12 / 4）；第二组可再拆成两份并带标签（≤ 14 / 6）。

fits.zh: 解说片的答案用同一批东西的比例讲出来。

notFor.zh: 第一次分超过两组；要精确到小数的百分比。

pairs.note: a brace or circle on the share

en: Name the rule of the sort ("sorted by") before the dots move.
The re-split takes its dots from one pile only; the other pile stays still.
zh: 再拆只从一堆里取点，另一堆不动。

waive.all: an own brick split from terminal-ledger kit: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the kit's approved example film at the same moments (the style's recipe, card: Differs from upstream)
